plane3d_heading.note: Sequential relay autotuning: bank → heading → altitude stick → altitude power.

_meta.description: PID gains tuned via relay autotuning (Astrom-Hagglund). Re-generate with: python scripts/tune_pid.py
_meta.methodology: Relay feedback experiment: inject relay signal, measure sustained oscillation to extract ultimate gain (Ku) and period (Tu), then compute PID gains via tuning rules. Gain-scheduled across N operating points spanning the target range.

plane.note: MIMO relay: pid1=power loop, pid2=stick loop, both on altitude error.

plane3d_circle.note: Sequential relay autotuning: bank → radial → altitude stick → altitude power.

plane3d_figure8.note: Altitude loop re-searched against measured tracking error. The previous gains left it oscillating: the signed altitude error averaged only -5 to -28 m while its standard deviation was 67 to 333 m, with no correlation to bank angle, so the loop was neither drifting nor losing height in the turns -- it was swinging. All three gains wanted to rise by three to five times, which is an under-gained loop rather than an under-damped one. Mean tracking error over five seeds falls from 185 m to 90 m. Sequential relay autotuning: bank → heading → altitude stick → altitude power.

reactor.note: Relay autotuning, positive-gain (rod withdrawal raises power).

four_tank.note: CROSS pairing: pid1 drives v1 from h2, pid2 drives v2 from h1. gamma1+gamma2 = 0.4 puts the plant in Johansson's non-minimum-phase configuration where the RGA element lambda11 = -0.067, so the diagonal pairing is unusable -- closing one loop reverses the sign of the other and integral action trips the low-level limit within 40 steps. Tuned against the corrected target box and the tightened tracking band (0.05 m, was the full 1.45 m tank span). The tuner stops crediting reward once an episode trips and scores each candidate on four initial conditions.

patrol.note: Re-searched after the heading loop was changed to command a turn rate rather than a bank angle. Commanding bank left the loop gain proportional to 1/V, a 45% swing across the speeds the follower flies, and every failing encounter spent 13-22% of its episode pinned at the 30 deg bank limit while the one that held formation never reached it. Inverting the coordinated-turn relation removed both. These gains are chosen for survival rather than settled error: 5 of 6 encounters completed against 2 of 6, at 135 m mean slot error against 130 m. Still outside the 60 m tolerance, so the formation tests remain xfail.

glass_furnace.note: Grid search over (Kp, Ki, Kd) maximising mean cumulative env reward. Relay autotuning fails on this plant: the crown temperature integrates the firing rate, so under a bang-bang relay it drifts without sustained zero-crossings and Astrom-Hagglund has no Ku/Tu to extract.

distillation.note: LV pairing: yD<-L (positive gain), xB<-V (negative -- more boilup strips the bottoms cleaner, lowering xB). Grid search over (Kp, Ki); return rises monotonically to Kp~400 with no instability, but 150 captures 98% of it at a quarter of the control activity, which is the safer margin on a plant with RGA ~50.

wind_turbine.note: Pitch PI on rotor-speed error; generator torque is a feedforward for the power setpoint with rotor-speed protection. Return is flat above Kp~12 (392 vs 394 at Kp=25) and all episodes complete without tripping, so 12 keeps a factor-2 gain margin on a rate-limited pitch actuator.

cement_kiln.note: Cascade: free lime trims a burning-zone setpoint, fuel holds it, kiln speed follows feed to hold bed depth. The outer loop is strongly proportional with weak integral (Kp 12000 / Ki 6) -- integral action on a measurement half an hour behind the input oscillates at the delay period. Return 176 over 4 seeds against 37 for the best constant action.

boiler_drum.note: Three-element: feedwater tracks measured steam flow as a feedforward and the level PI only trims it, bounded to 25 kg/s. A fast level loop reacts to swell by cutting feedwater exactly when mass is leaving fastest. Return 215-296 against 5 for the best constant action, which trips in 5-117 steps.
